text: 2 uL plasmid DNA from plasmid plate A1 into the competent-cell tube A1 with the 20 uL pipette.
Heat shock at 42 C for 45 s, then 2 min on ice, recorded in that order after DNA addition.
250 uL SOC added to the tube after the heat shock, and the 37 C, 60 min, 250 rpm outgrowth recorded.
A fresh tip for the DNA and for the SOC, no contamination of cells or stocks, and the tip dropped at the end.
No missing or reordered steps and nothing added that would change the outcome; comments and metadata are accurate.
